data.title: Crypto Exchanges Expand Trading in Contracts Tied to Stocks, Indexes and Commodities
data.description:
Crypto exchanges are becoming much larger venues for trading contracts tied to stocks, indexes and commodities, adding fresh evidence that digital assets and traditional markets are starting to merge.

According to Bloomberg, the growth in this type of trading is adding fresh evidence that the worlds of digital assets and traditional markets are starting to merge.

data.title: Dangote Wins Approval for $1.6 Billion Refinery IPO
data.description: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote is seeking to raise $1.6 billion in an initial public offering for his refinery, Africa’s largest, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Glencore Described as Radiant World’s ‘Senior Partner,’ Executive Says
data.description: A top executive at one of the firms linked to Radiant World said the relationship with Glencore Plc was one of “senior partner-junior partner,” according to Bloomberg.

data.title: STOCKS | MSCI Nordic Countries Index Holds Steady at 402.61 Points
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, the MSCI Nordic Countries Index was roughly unchanged at 402.61 points, with the telecom sector posting the biggest decline among the 10 sectors and Novonesis Novozymes B falling 3.1% to lead Nordic stocks lower.

data.title: Hyperliquid to Lower Outcome Order Minimum to $1 in Next Network Upgrade
data.description: Hyperliquid said it will reduce the minimum notional value for outcome orders, or prediction market result token orders, from $10 to $1 in its next network upgrade. According to Foresight News, deployers will also be able to check their remaining limits through the outcomeDeployerLimits information request interface.

data.title: Hyperliquid to Lower Minimum Result Order Size to $1 After Next Network Upgrade
data.description: HyperliquidNews said on X that the minimum order amount for result orders will be reduced from $10 to $1 after the next network upgrade. According to Odaily, the change will take effect following the upgrade.

data.title: Blue Owl Tech Fund Raises $150 Million in Private Placement
data.description:
Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. raised $150 million through a private placement, its third financing since June, according to Bloomberg.

The software-focused private credit fund said Friday it completed the latest financing round.

data.title: WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert to Retire at Year-End
data.description: The Women’s National Basketball Association said Cathy Engelbert, its first commissioner, will retire at the end of the year, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Tanker Market Pulls Back as Russia-India Crude Freight Holds Firm
data.description: According to Jin10, the Mediterranean tanker market has recently fallen sharply, with Riverlake saying freight for a 140,000-dwt crude tanker from the Black Sea to the Mediterranean has dropped to 280 Worldscale points from about WS570 in mid-August, while cross-Mediterranean freight has also fallen by about 100 Worldscale points since the second half of August to WS280 at the start of September. Another shipbroker said freight may have already fallen to around WS200, but traders said freight to ship Urals crude from Novorossiysk to India has remained broadly unchanged at about $18 million to $20 million per voyage.

data.title: West Ham Control Battle Intensifies as Sullivan, Kretinsky Increase Stakes
data.description:
The battle for control of West Ham United took another twist as former chairman David Sullivan, who faces allegations of historical sex abuse, increased his stake in the London football club, according to Bloomberg.

Czech billionaire Daniel Kretinsky also became the club's biggest shareholder.

data.title: STOCKS | FICO Drops 21% as Pulte Repeats Criticism of Credit Score Costs
data.description:
Shares of Fair Isaac Corp., Equifax Inc. and TransUnion fell on Friday after Federal Housing Finance Agency Director Bill Pulte renewed his criticism of the cost of consumer credit scores, according to Bloomberg.

Fair Isaac dropped 21%.

data.title: DoubleLine Sees Value in GOOGL, AMZN Bonds After AI Debt Selloff
data.description:
DoubleLine Capital’s Robert Cohen said debt issued by some large technology companies is starting to look attractive after an AI-fueled borrowing spree hurt valuations, according to Bloomberg.

The comments singled out bonds tied to GOOGL and AMZN.

data.title: STOCKS | BSE to extend price band rules to index futures from September 7
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) said the price limit rules for the closing call auction phase will be extended to stock index futures from September 7.

data.title: Apple Shares Fall 2.5% to $320.055, Market Value at $4.67 Trillion
data.description: Apple shares fell 2.5% to $320.055 apiece, with the company’s market value at $4.67 trillion, according to Jiemian News.

data.title: Balancer Sends On-Chain Message to Balancer V1 Attacker, Offers Bounty for Returned Funds
data.description:
Balancer said it has sent on-chain messages to known addresses linked to the Balancer V1 attack, offering the attacker a channel to make contact and return funds. According to Foresight News, the attacker is asked to respond privately through Blockscan before 5:00 on September 9 and begin the contact process.

Balancer said that if no response is received by the deadline, it will be treated as a refusal to cooperate and the company will escalate its response. If the attacker returns funds to the DAO multisig address, Balancer said it will negotiate a bounty and will not pursue or prosecute solely because the funds were returned, once the return is verified to meet the conditions.

If the attacker does not respond on time or rejects the proposal, Balancer said it will use all technical, on-chain, and legal means to pursue and prosecute the attacker. It added that the bounty would then be redirected to reward whistleblowers who help identify the attacker.

Balancer previously said on August 31 that a vulnerability in its legacy v1 contracts could allow LP funds to be stolen. The affected pools have been deprecated and cannot be paused, and users were advised to withdraw liquidity as soon as possible. Balancer said its other products were not affected by the vulnerability.

data.title: STOCKS | Strong U.S. Jobs Data Revives Fed Rate-Hike Bets, Bitcoin Falls Below $80,000
data.description:
U.S. jobs data came in stronger than expected, reviving market bets on a September Fed rate hike and sending Bitcoin down nearly 3%. According to Sina Finance, the latest rally above $80,000 came to an abrupt end.

The August nonfarm payrolls increased by 162,000, above every economist's forecast in a Bloomberg survey, while the unemployment rate held at 4.1%. After the data, Bitcoin fell alongside stocks and bonds, briefly dropping 2.8% to $79,197. The two-year U.S. Treasury yield rose and the dollar strengthened.

Sygnum Bank Chief Investment Officer Fabian Dori said stronger economic data does not end the policy debate and instead gives hawks more support. He added that the data confirms current market pricing for the probability of a September rate hike.

data.title: US Measles Cases Reach 3,134 Amid Death-Count Dispute
data.description:
The US has confirmed 3,134 measles cases so far this year, according to Bloomberg.

The outbreak in Pennsylvania has been linked to two deaths and sparked a dispute between the governor and the nation’s top health leader.

data.title: STOCKS | Domestic Futures Mostly Rise as Synthetic Rubber Gains Nearly 5%
data.description: According to Jin10, at the 23:00 close, most of China's domestic futures benchmark contracts rose, with synthetic rubber up nearly 5%, caustic soda up more than 3%, TSR20 rubber up nearly 3%, soda ash and rubber up more than 2%, while fuel oil fell more than 2%.

data.title: Smart Money Trader Yixie Longs ZEC With 2x Leverage, Posts Over $9.5 Million in Gains
data.description: On-chain analyst Ai Yi said smart money trader yixie has made more than $9.503 million from long positions in ZEC. According to Odaily, the trader holds a $20 million ZEC long position using 2x leverage, with $1.038 million in realized gains and $8.465 million in unrealized gains. The trader has not disclosed a take-profit target. Earlier, @yixie10 was mainly active on Hyperliquid and previously profited more than $6.5 million from an AI sector bet.

data.title: ZEC Long Position by Smart Money Wallet Yixie10 Tops $9.5 Million in Profit
data.description:
A smart money wallet identified as yixie10 has made more than $9.503 million in cumulative profit from a long ZEC position, according to Ai Yi monitoring. According to Foresight News, the address holds a $20 million ZEC long position with 2x leverage, including $1.038 million in realized profit and $8.465 million in unrealized gains, and has not disclosed a take-profit target.

The address was previously active on Hyperliquid and had earlier profited more than $6.5 million from an AI sector trade.
